South Bend, Indiana

Welcome to the Rockne House

I had spent my life dedicated to football. As my playing career wound down, I landed on a new chapter: creating homes like this at the Meccas of the sport, places where people can gather around the game we love.

Rockne House began with its address: 2121 Rockne Drive, at the corner of the street named for Knute Rockne, the patriarch of Notre Dame football and, in many ways, of the sport itself. Renovating it meant doing justice to the name on the street sign. Even the number tied the house to another football Mecca: the Pro Football Hall of Fame stands at 2121 George Halas Drive. A home at 2121 Rockne Drive demanded an authentic dedication to the game.

Signed: Matthew, Paulinha, Koa and Rio

Settle in

Amenities

Heating and cooling

The Amazon thermostat adjusts right on the unit. The snowflake icon is A/C and the fire icon is heat. The whole house fan can be adjusted as well.

At a glance: snowflake for cooling, fire for heat.

Kitchen and coffee

The kitchen is fully stocked. The coffee station has a Keurig Duo, so you can brew normal drip carafes or use the single-serve side with the reusable k-cup adapter. We do not provide k-cups, but you are welcome to bring and use your own.

We set out Pilao ground coffee for guests, which is what my Brazilian in-laws swear by, so we put it in all of our houses. A decaf option is there too. There is an electric kettle for teas, and you will find EmergenC in the coffee area in case anyone could use an immune boost after rough travels.

The massive hot tub

The 10-person Down East East Hampton tub has a large rollable cover. Four arms extend to hold the cover when it is rolled back, please use them. We leave it on at 101F and it can go up to 104F. Guests never need to shut the tub off when they leave, it always stays on.

Cooler than expected? It was likely reset to vacation or econ mode by mistake. Switching the mode back to standard fixes it. Reach out with any doubts and we will help.

Football Flicks cinema

The basement cinema has a 110-inch screen with surround sound. Turn the projector on with the black Yaber remote, then control streaming through the Amazon Fire Stick hooked to the projector. If it does not immediately boot to the Amazon menus, swap the projector source to HDMI 1.

The studio speakers only work through the Fire Stick. You are welcome to hook up your own system, such as a video game console, but the cinema sound only works through Amazon. TVs around the house carry NFL+ Premium, Max, Hulu, Disney+, and Amazon Prime.

Game room

The game room has pool, Pop-A-Shot, and Football Toss. We keep house record boards for our Pop-A-Shot games and we love to have guests try to qualify, so take your shot at the board.

Outdoors

The backyard has a fire pit, a basketball hoop, and a BBQ deck. Everything you need for a long evening outside is right there.

Guest traditions

Good to know

Kiss Me I'm Irish wall

Find the wall and add your mark to it. Write your family name, where you came from, and the date on a ribbon, then hang it with the rest. It is one of our favorite traditions in the house.

Play like a champion

Enjoy pool, Pop-A-Shot, Football Toss, and the outdoor basketball hoop. If you have the score, take your shot at the Pop-A-Shot house record board.

Late nights outside

The fire pit, backyard seating, basketball hoop, BBQ deck, and hot tub are all set up for long evenings together.

BBQ deck

The deck gives the group a dedicated outdoor cooking and gathering space beside the rest of the backyard amenities.

Around South Bend

Local Recommendations

Our favorite stops near 2121 Rockne Drive, from post-game dinners to the practical basics. Game weekends book fast, so reserve ahead when noted and confirm hours before you go.

Matt's Picks

If you only have time for a few stops, start with the three marked below. These are my own personal favorites: Rocco's for pizza and Notre Dame history, Evil Czech for brunch, and the Linebacker for game day energy. Look for the gold badge on each one.

Restaurants 6 picks

Rocco's Restaurant Matt's pick

537 N St Louis Blvd, South Bend, IN 46617

Family owned pizzeria and Italian spot since 1951, with ND memorabilia on the walls and huge portions for the table.

Matt says: The pizza place near campus with all the memorabilia on the walls. A real blast from the past, and still one of my favorite meals near the house.

Fiddler's Hearth Public House

127 N Main St, South Bend, IN 46601

Authentic Irish public house downtown with live Irish music, scotch eggs, shepherd's pie, and proper pints.

O'Rourke's Public House

1044 E Angela Blvd #103, Eddy Street Commons, South Bend, IN 46617

Irish style sports pub steps from campus with 14 TVs and an HD projector, corned beef, wings, and Irish stew.

Crooked Ewe Brewery and Ale House

1047 Lincolnway E, South Bend, IN 46601

Riverfront brewpub with house brewed pints, smoked wings, brisket melt, and poutine, plus a separate vegan menu.

Cafe Navarre

101 N Michigan St, South Bend, IN 46601

Upscale downtown restaurant in a historic former bank building with seafood, steaks, and handmade pasta. Reserve ahead on game weekends.

Corndance Tavern

4725 Grape Rd, Mishawaka, IN 46545

Seasonally driven steakhouse with Midwestern beef dry aged and cut in house, local farm produce, and Great Lakes seafood.

Bars and breweries 4 picks

South Bend Brew Werks

321 S Main St, Suite 105B, South Bend, IN 46601

Community focused downtown brewpub with rotating house beers, gourmet grilled cheese, flatbreads, and live music. Note the current address on Main St.

Evil Czech Brewery Matt's pick

3703 N Main St, Mishawaka, IN 46545

Locally owned brewery with hand crafted ales, a large brewpub menu, and a weekend Hangover Brunch buffet.

Matt says: The Czech brew house I always recommend. Go for the brunch with the mini plates, you get to try a little of everything.

The Exchange Whiskey Bar

112 W Jefferson Blvd, South Bend, IN 46601

Speakeasy style lounge in a repurposed 1920s bank with an extensive whiskey list and inventive cocktails.

Linebacker Lounge, The Backer Matt's pick

1631 South Bend Ave, South Bend, IN 46617

Quintessential ND dive bar across from campus since 1962, known for cheap drinks and the famed Bloody Mary. Packed on game weekends.

Matt says: The spot for Notre Dame events. If you want to feel game day like a local, this is where I would send you.

Breakfast and coffee 2 picks

Peggs

Beloved downtown breakfast bistro known for pull apart cinnamon rolls, Bananas Foster French Toast, and chicken and waffles. Open 7 AM on weekends, closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

Java Cafe

201 S Main St, South Bend, IN 46601

Martin's Super Markets

2081 South Bend Ave, South Bend, IN 46637

Local grocery since 1947 with bakery, deli, produce, and meat. Open 6 AM to midnight daily, the closest full stock up to the house.

Football and sports attractions 3 picks

Notre Dame Stadium, Football Friday Tunnel Experience

2010 Moose Krause Circle, Notre Dame, IN 46556

Walk the North Tunnel on home game Fridays for $10 per person, with limited field access for photos. Buy online about two weeks ahead, gates close at 2:30 PM.

Hammes Notre Dame Bookstore

1234 N Eddy St #101, Eddy Street Commons, South Bend, IN 46617

The official ND bookstore with 65,000 square feet of Under Armour gear, apparel, books, and souvenirs, minutes from the house.

Notre Dame Campus Traditions Walk

University of Notre Dame campus, Notre Dame, IN 46556

Free walk covering the Grotto of Our Lady of Lourdes, the Basilica of the Sacred Heart, and the Word of Life Mural known as Touchdown Jesus. Free tours run from the Eck Visitors Center.

Family and outdoor activities 4 picks

Potawatomi Zoo

500 S Greenlawn Ave, South Bend, IN 46615

Indiana's oldest zoo with over 400 animals, giraffe feedings, a train and carousel, and a new Big Cat Tracks exhibit. Free for ages 2 and under.

South Bend Cubs at Four Winds Field

501 W South St, South Bend, IN 46601

Chicago Cubs High-A baseball in a downtown retro park with lawn seats around $10, a splash pad, and fireworks nights. Season runs spring through early September.

Howard Park

219 S St Louis Blvd, South Bend, IN 46617

Reimagined riverfront park with playgrounds, splash area, picnic lawns, and a 16,000 square foot ice skating trail in winter.

Potato Creek State Park

25601 State Road 4, North Liberty, IN 46554

3,800 acre park about 12 miles southwest with Worster Lake for fishing and kayaking, hiking trails, swimming beach, and nature center.

Practical: pharmacy and urgent care 2 picks

Walgreens

1351 N Ironwood Dr, South Bend, IN 46615

Closest pharmacy to the house, open 7 AM to midnight daily with pharmacy until 9 PM, photo services, and everyday essentials.

Beacon MedPoint Urgent Care, Ireland Road

1815 E Ireland Rd, South Bend, IN 46614

Beacon Health System walk in urgent care for minor injuries and illnesses with on site lab and X ray, open daily 8 AM to 8 PM.

Tip: Tippecanoe Place is closed, so it is not on this list. For South Bend Brew Werks, use the 321 S Main St address above, the pub has moved from Michigan St.

Before you go

Check-out

A few things our cleaners appreciate, not a chore list. If you are short on time, do not worry about any of this.

  • Leave beds unmade, no need to strip them
  • Put used towels in the shower
  • Load and start the dishwasher
  • Empty the trash
  • Return furniture and items to their places
  • Set the climate controls appropriately
  • Lock the doors and windows

Thank you for staying with us at the Rockne House.

We hope the house gave you a few stories worth retelling. Come back anytime.
